measurement_and_specification_defects.what: The world had zero variance: items were drawn once per attempt and the organism is deterministic, so every score was a single exact number.
measurement_and_specification_defects.why_invalid: infometrics.effect_clears_null requires independent estimates across seed blocks; with no variance the noise-floor gate could not be built at all and Q11 was unsatisfiable. Evolution also optimised against one frozen 120-item list.
measurement_and_specification_defects.exposed_by: reading the world before running it, while checking whether Q11 could be evaluated
measurement_and_specification_defects.replaced_with: demand STRUCTURE attempt-stable (capability assignment plus a 48-template pool), items drawn PER EPISODE from that pool

measurement_and_specification_defects.what: superadditivity() forwarded the intervention (force_disjunctive=True) to the mixture but not to solo_values().
measurement_and_specification_defects.why_invalid: The mixture was measured under one composition law and its own baselines under another. The comparison spanned two different worlds while producing a clean-looking number.
measurement_and_specification_defects.exposed_by: reading the call site after the M3 result inverted; the numbers alone looked decisive
measurement_and_specification_defects.replaced_with: **kw propagated to every baseline; lib/learnability.assert_controlled added as a standing guard

measurement_and_specification_defects.what: Superadditivity was defined on score = info/cost, whose denominator contains an item-attempt floor of 60.0 paid by every organism.
measurement_and_specification_defects.why_invalid: Summing solo SURPLUSES of a ratio double-counts that floor's dilution, inflating the additive prediction. Measured: complementary -0.2184, arbitrary -0.5231, carry-all -0.9712 - all negative as an artefact of the denominator.
measurement_and_specification_defects.exposed_by: every hand-built set reading negative, including ones that obviously composed
measurement_and_specification_defects.replaced_with: superadditivity defined on INFORMATION, which composes linearly; carry cost reported separately

measurement_and_specification_defects.what: Carrying was priced rather than budgeted, and score proved monotone in components carried at every swept price (3.0, 6.0, 10.0, 15.0, 22.0, 30.0).
measurement_and_specification_defects.why_invalid: Conjunctive demand makes marginal value INCREASING, because each added component unlocks new combinations. Info grows about 13x from singleton to carry-all while cost grows about 5x, so a linear price cannot make carrying contested at any value.
measurement_and_specification_defects.exposed_by: a price sweep whose declared selection rule returned None - no price satisfied it
measurement_and_specification_defects.replaced_with: a carry BUDGET B=3, fixed by the measured mean conjunctive demand size (2.57 over 28 templates), declared before superadditivity was inspected

measurement_and_specification_defects.what: The first M3 criterion compared raw superadditivity ACROSS composition laws and required it to collapse toward zero with the law off.
measurement_and_specification_defects.why_invalid: Raw superadditivity is not comparable across laws: under disjunction the additive prediction is inflated by coverage OVERLAP, since the sum of solo information greatly exceeds the union. That is arithmetic, not composition.
measurement_and_specification_defects.exposed_by: disjunctive superadditivity reading -79.54 against conjunctive -5.56, a difference too large to be a composition effect
measurement_and_specification_defects.replaced_with: within-law contrasts, and ultimately the difference-in-differences on normalised superadditivity

measurement_and_specification_defects.what: The replacement criterion required gap_conj > abs(gap_disj), an invented magnitude threshold.
measurement_and_specification_defects.why_invalid: The threshold does not follow from the hypothesis. It reported FAIL on +18.25 vs -23.55, which is in fact the predicted dissociation: alignment helps under conjunction and hurts under disjunction. The printed conclusion 'alignment pays equally without conjunctions' was also false.
measurement_and_specification_defects.exposed_by: re-reading the numbers behind a FAIL verdict that contradicted their direction
measurement_and_specification_defects.replaced_with: difference-in-differences on NORMALISED superadditivity, immune to the scale differences that broke both prior criteria

measurement_and_specification_defects.what: The 'complementary' probe set [4,5,6] was hand-picked from the single most common conjunctive demand.
measurement_and_specification_defects.why_invalid: It scored 1.3570 while a random subset [2,3,6] scored 1.7676 - 30% better. Serving one common conjunction while neglecting everything else is not optimal, so the best-case probe was not a best case.
measurement_and_specification_defects.exposed_by: a budget-binding check that happened to sample random subsets
measurement_and_specification_defects.replaced_with: exhaustive enumeration of all C(8,3)=56 subsets; BEST [0,2,4], WORST [4,5,7]

superseded_criteria_summary._reading: Three of the seven defects were criteria rather than measurements. That is the finding the operator identified as primary: the criterion itself became an experimental object.
